reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Accelerating the implementation of prevention services and quality care in the fight against the epidemics of HIV and TB - Togo (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Togo, HIV, Primature de la République Togolaise (PMT)This program has the following goals: Reduce new infections in the general population. Reduce mortality among PLWHIV (adults, adolescents, children). Make the social, political and legal environment supportive of continued access to and use of HIV services for key populations and PLHIV. Making the governance of the response to HIV and AIDS effective. The objectives of this program are: 95% of key populations (e.g., SWs, MSM, DU/IDU, Prisoners) use combination prevention services by 2025.. 90% of vulnerable populations (men and women in uniform, mobile populations, fisherfolk, youth porters Portefaix , PLWHIV,) use combination prevention services by 2025. 95% of in-school and out-of-school adolescents and young people aged 10-24 adopt low-risk behaviours to avoid HIV and STIs by 2025. 95% of HIV-positive pregnant women and their children use PMTCT services to reduce MTCT of HIV and congenital syphilis by 2025. 100% safety transfusion by 2025. By 2025, 95% of PLWHIV know their HIV status. By 2025, 95% of PLWHIV who know their HIV status are receiving antiretroviral treatment.
